description: Delete a SCIM group-to-workspace mapping by mapping_id and stop future group updates from affecting that workspace. Existing provisioned members remain in the workspace and must be managed separately. Inspect list_scim_workspace_mappings first; this does not delete the identity-provider group or the Portkey workspace. Enterprise-gated. Returns 403 on non-Enterprise Portkey plans.

mapping_id.description: SCIM workspace mapping ID from list_scim_workspace_mappings

name: delete_scim_workspace_mapping

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
